items.title: Drone with Powerful Missile
items.description: A custom drone build in Spaceflight Simulator equipped with a powerful in-game missile. Download the blueprint and try it in your own game.

items.title: Magnetic Lift Arm
items.description: A compact Spaceflight Simulator surface utility rig featuring a tall strut frame, docking ports, a probe, solar array, fuel tank, and parachutes. Built as a magnetic-style lifting and handling arm for moving or docking with nearby craft.
